mechanism: Isocarboxazid (MAOI) potentiates diazepam's CNS depressant effects through additive depression of the central nervous system, and may inhibit diazepam metabolism via CYP3A4/2C19 inhibition.
action: Use with caution; consider alternative anxiolytic or reduce diazepam dose by 30-50% with close monitoring for excessive sedation, respiratory depression, and impaired psychomotor function.
